name: Dura-Ace 10 mm-pitch track front hub
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 225 g for the complete front HB-7020 solid-axle, nut-fastened track hub. The manufacturer drawing confirms a solid axle and hub nuts, with no quick-release skewer. The weighed spoke-hole count is not identified; no nut or axle mass is subtracted.
